purpose: Machine-readable inventory of the single normative source for every config/governance rule. One rule, one canonical source; everything else references or is marked superseded/archive.

layers.UPSTREAM_OFFICIAL: read-only discovery of installed client schema/capability/defaults/config roots
layers.USER_OVERLAY: WORK-LAB-managed portable user Rules, Skills, plugin declarations, explicit preferences
layers.PROJECT_OVERLAY: owned by each project repository; WORK-LAB reads declared pointers only
layers.TASK_EPHEMERAL: WORK-LAB Task Ledger leases/checkpoints/temp task context
layers.RUNTIME_EPHEMERAL: sessions, caches, logs, runtime state — not committed, not collected
layers.SECRET: credentials, auth, tokens, prompt/response bodies — FORBIDDEN to persist

config_fields.role: single field-level authority; schema_version=workflow/config-ownership/v2; single_authority=true; unknown fields default OBSERVE/quarantine

layering_and_boundary_standard.role: interprets the layering model and per-product boundaries; MUST NOT duplicate the field table owned by config-ownership.json

adapter_registry.role: client adapter inventory for the global runner

project_profile_registry.role: external project cooperation endpoints: address + protocol metadata only; never project content

gate_plan_schema.role: gate plan contract; tier vocabulary is global (TARGETED/STAGE/NIGHTLY/RC/RELEASE), semantic mapping is project-owned

task_ledger_schema.role: WORK-LAB task truth; task ids, idempotency keys, ledger event digests

managed_config_schema.role: isolated-empty-home compatibility recipe only; field lists superseded by config-ownership.json (see note in official-plus-user standard)

workflow_root_gate.role: the only active GitHub workflow authority for WORK-LAB

nested_governance_workflow.role: documented example / reusable source only; not an active second CI authority (WLG-080)

archive_manifests.role: historical migration/audit/handoff evidence; superseded docs live here, Git history is never rewritten

execution_rules.role: root execution rules for all managed clients and modules

skills_inventory.role: managed skills SHA256 inventory; deployed via sync_hermes_workflow_assets.py

plugins_inventory.role: managed plugin inventory (Hermes plugins + Agent Plugins v1); to be created by WLR-080

models_registry.role: provider/model pricing and capability registry; to be created by WLR-050

context_capsules.role: Context Continuity Protocol capsule inventory; to be created by WLR-030

telemetry.role: TokenTelemetry / observer telemetry authority; to be created by WLR-110

observer.role: read-only projection of workflow state; strict observer — no write/approve/retry/rollback

federation.role: cross-project federation protocol (WORK-LAB ↔ ArcheAxis ↔ DESIGN-LAB); to be defined

rule: Each rule has exactly one normative source. Other files either reference the authority or are marked SUPERSEDED/ARCHIVE. Adding a duplicate field table or a second CI authority is a WLG violation.
